"""Retained terrain native responses as ordinary scientific report sources.

TokenJunkieLabs. Reads completed native records; no terrain or model execution.
"""
from __future__ import annotations
from copy import deepcopy
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
from model.common import (atomic_bytes, atomic_json, describe_file, digest, file_digest,
                          held, identifier, read_json, verify_file)
from source_tools import terrain_conditioning as terrain
from source_tools import terrain_conditioning_response as response

KIND = "terrain-conditioning-report-sources"
FOLDER = "terrain-conditioning-report-source-output"
SCHEMA = "upstate.terrain-conditioning-report-source/v1"
VERSION = "terrain-native-scientific-source-20261013-v1"

def normalize(selection):
    if not isinstance(selection, dict) or set(selection) != {"response_id", "title", "reason"}:
        raise ValueError("Choose a completed original terrain response, report title and interpretation purpose")
    result = {"response_id": identifier(selection["response_id"])}
    for name in ("title", "reason"):
        value = selection[name]
        if not isinstance(value, str) or not value.strip():
            raise ValueError("Retain the report " + name)
        result[name] = value.strip()
    return result

def _source_entry(ws, collection_id, source_id):
    collection = ws._get("sources", identifier(collection_id))
    entry = next((e for e in collection["entries"] if e["id"] == source_id), None)
    if entry is None:
        raise ValueError("Retain the original terrain input source")
    for body in [entry["body"], *entry.get("companions", [])]:
        verify_file(ws.root, {**body, "path": body["object"]})
    return {"collection_id": collection_id, "entry": deepcopy(entry)}

def _bind(ws, selection):
    selected = normalize(selection)
    original = response.inspect(ws, selected["response_id"])
    if original.get("state") != "complete" or original.get("schema") != "upstate.terrain-native-response/v1":
        raise ValueError("Complete the original native terrain response before issuing a scientific source")
    case_id = identifier(original["selection"]["case_id"])
    case = terrain.inspect(ws, case_id, verify=True)
    if case.get("state") != "complete":
        raise ValueError("Retain the completed original terrain case")
    baseline = ws.inspect_run(original["selection"]["baseline_run_id"])
    alternatives = [ws.inspect_run(row["run_id"]) for row in original["selection"]["alternatives"]]
    runs = [baseline, *alternatives]
    for run in runs:
        if run.get("state") != "complete" or digest(run["selection"]) != run["id"]:
            raise ValueError("Retain every exact completed native run")
    snapshots = [describe_file(ws.root, ws.root / response.KIND / (selected["response_id"] + ".json")),
                 describe_file(ws.root, ws.root / response.FOLDER / selected["response_id"] / "result.json"),
                 describe_file(ws.root, ws.root / terrain.KIND / (case_id + ".json")),
                 describe_file(ws.root, ws.root / terrain.RUNS / case_id / "result.json")]
    # The response already retains immutable copies of its original run.json
    # records and native outputs. Their exact descriptors below bind this
    # historical analysis without freezing unrelated later live-run stages.
    source_records = [_source_entry(ws, case["case"]["dem"]["collection_id"], case["case"]["dem"]["source_id"])]
    hydro = case["case"].get("hydrography")
    if hydro:
        source_records.append(_source_entry(ws, hydro["collection_id"], hydro["source_id"]))
    quantities = {}
    for row in original["rows"]:
        if row["metric"] not in quantities:
            quantities[row["metric"]] = {"units": row["units"], "joint_valid_cells": row["joint_valid_cells"],
                "joint_area_ha": row["joint_area_ha"], "baseline_joint_total": row["baseline_joint_total"]}
        elif quantities[row["metric"]] != {"units": row["units"], "joint_valid_cells": row["joint_valid_cells"],
                "joint_area_ha": row["joint_area_ha"], "baseline_joint_total": row["baseline_joint_total"]}:
            raise ValueError("Retained terrain alternatives do not share the same native quantity support")
    binding = {"project_id": ws.project["id"], "case_id": case_id, "response_id": original["id"],
        "baseline_run_id": baseline["id"], "alternatives": deepcopy(original["selection"]["alternatives"]),
        "native_versions": deepcopy(original["selection"]["native_versions"]),
        "case": deepcopy(case["case"]), "source_classification": original.get("source_classification"),
        "original_source_records": source_records, "original_records": snapshots,
        "original_response_files": deepcopy(original["files"]), "quantity_support": quantities,
        "direction": "alternative minus baseline", "sum_basis": "original normalized pixel mass summed once"}
    return selected, binding, original, case

def _producer():
    from model import terrain_conditioning_scientific_report as report
    from model import scientific_report, scientific_figures, native_versions
    paths = [Path(__file__), Path(report.__file__), Path(scientific_report.__file__),
             Path(scientific_figures.__file__), Path(native_versions.__file__)]
    return {p.name: {"bytes": p.stat().st_size, "sha256": file_digest(p)} for p in paths}, paths

def _body(ws, selected, binding):
    producer, paths = _producer()
    return {"schema": "upstate." + KIND + "/v1", "project_id": ws.project["id"], **selected, "case_id": binding["case_id"],
            "binding": binding, "producer": producer}, paths

def _verify_binding(ws, binding):
    if binding["project_id"] != ws.project["id"]:
        raise ValueError("Open the terrain report's original project")
    for item in binding["original_records"] + binding["original_response_files"]:
        verify_file(ws.root, item)
    case = terrain.inspect(ws, binding["case_id"], verify=True)
    original = response.inspect(ws, binding["response_id"])
    if case["case"] != binding["case"] or original.get("state") != "complete":
        raise ValueError("Original terrain source or completed response changed")
    for source in binding["original_source_records"]:
        actual = _source_entry(ws, source["collection_id"], source["entry"]["id"])
        # Source-view paths are historical import provenance. Source objects and
        # scientific metadata are verified through the original collection.
        if actual != source:
            raise ValueError("Original terrain input source record changed")

def preview(ws, selection):
    selected, binding, original, case = _bind(ws, selection)
    body, _ = _body(ws, selected, binding)
    key = digest(body)
    result = {"id": key, "state": "ready", "selection": selected, "binding": binding,
              "summary": {"response_id": original["id"], "case_id": case["id"],
                "native_alternatives": len(binding["alternatives"]),
                "quantities": list(binding["quantity_support"]),
                "source_classification": binding["source_classification"]}}
    if (ws.root / FOLDER / key / "result.json").exists():
        result["state"] = "existing"
        result["existing"] = inspect(ws, key)
    return result

def _source_matches(ws, result, root):
    collection = ws._get("sources", result["source"]["source_collection_id"])
    entry = next((e for e in collection["entries"] if e["id"] == result["source"]["source_id"]), None)
    if entry is None:
        raise ValueError("The original terrain scientific source is missing")
    declared = read_json(root / "sources.json")["entries"][0]
    expected = {v["path"]: (v["bytes"], v["sha256"]) for v in [declared, *declared["companions"]]}
    actual = {v.get("view_path", v["filename"]): (v["bytes"], v["sha256"])
              for v in [entry["body"], *entry.get("companions", [])]}
    if actual != expected:
        raise ValueError("Retain every original terrain report, figure and map companion")
    for v in [entry["body"], *entry.get("companions", [])]:
        verify_file(ws.root, {**v, "path": v["object"]})
    return entry

def inspect(ws, key):
    selection = ws._get(KIND, identifier(key))
    root = ws.root / FOLDER / key
    path = root / "result.json"
    if not path.exists():
        return {"schema": SCHEMA, "id": key, "state": "prepared", "selection": selection,
                "binding": selection["binding"], "files": []}
    result = read_json(path)
    if (result.get("schema") != SCHEMA or result.get("id") != key
            or result.get("selection") != selection or result.get("binding") != selection["binding"]):
        raise ValueError("The retained terrain report identity changed")
    _verify_binding(ws, result["binding"])
    for member in result["files"]:
        verify_file(ws.root, member)
    _source_matches(ws, result, root)
    return result

def catalog(ws):
    items, issues = [], []
    for row in ws._list(KIND):
        try:
            value = inspect(ws, row["id"])
            items.append({"id": row["id"], "title": row["title"], "response_id": row["response_id"],
                          "case_id": row["case_id"], "state": value["state"], "source": value.get("source")})
        except (ValueError, KeyError, OSError) as error:
            issues.append({"id": row["id"], "message": str(error)})
    return {"project_id": ws.project["id"], "report_sources": items, "issues": issues}

def prepare(ws, selection, progress=None):
    from model import terrain_conditioning_scientific_report as report
    selected, binding, original, case = _bind(ws, selection)
    body, modules = _body(ws, selected, binding)
    key = digest(body)
    root = ws.root / FOLDER / key
    root.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    with held(root / ".report.lock", blocking=False):
        record = ws._save(KIND, body)
        if record["id"] != key:
            raise ValueError("The original terrain report identity differs")
        if (root / "result.json").exists():
            return inspect(ws, key)
        def emit(stage):
            if progress:
                progress({"report_source_id": key, "response_id": original["id"], "stage": stage})
        emit("retaining_original_response")
        atomic_json(root / "selection.json", record, immutable=True)
        atomic_json(root / "input-binding.json", binding, immutable=True)
        atomic_json(root / "original-native-response.json", original, immutable=True)
        atomic_json(root / "original-terrain-case.json", case, immutable=True)
        for module in modules:
            payload = module.read_bytes()
            declared = body["producer"][module.name]
            import hashlib
            if len(payload) != declared["bytes"] or hashlib.sha256(payload).hexdigest() != declared["sha256"]:
                raise ValueError("The original terrain report implementation changed")
            atomic_bytes(root / "implementation" / module.name, payload, immutable=True)
        original_root = ws.root / response.FOLDER / original["id"]
        copied = []
        for item in original["files"]:
            path = verify_file(ws.root, item)
            relative = path.relative_to(original_root)
            # Full native originals are retained through the original response
            # Study closure. The report keeps every original table/map/legend.
            if relative.name == "index.html":
                continue
            if relative.parts[0] == "original-runs" and relative.name != "run.json":
                continue
            destination = root / "response" / relative
            destination.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            if destination.exists():
                if file_digest(destination) != item["sha256"]:
                    raise ValueError("A retained terrain report companion changed")
            else:
                shutil.copyfile(path, destination)
            copied.append(describe_file(root, destination))
        recipe_path = root / "report-source.json"
        if recipe_path.exists():
            recipe = read_json(recipe_path)
            for member in recipe["inputs"]:
                verify_file(root, member)
        else:
            emit("rendering_original_scientific_report")
            sections, figure_contract = report.write(root, record, original, case, copied)
            members = [describe_file(root, p) for p in sorted(root.rglob("*"))
                       if p.is_file() and p.name not in {".report.lock", "result.json", "sources.json", "report-source.json"}]
            recipe = {"schema": "upstate.observed-report/v1", "edition": VERSION, "title": selected["title"],
                      "project_id": ws.project["id"], "inputs": members, "sections": sections,
                      "source_links": ["report.html", "report.pdf", "report.md", "report-data.json",
                                       "original-native-response.json", "original-terrain-case.json",
                                       "response/native-response.csv", "input-binding.json"], **figure_contract}
            atomic_json(recipe_path, recipe, immutable=True)
        source_id = "terrain-conditioning-report-source-" + key
        entry = {"id": source_id, "kind": "document", "role": "OBSERVED_CONTEXT", "title": selected["title"],
            "uri": "urn:upstate:terrain-conditioning-report-source:" + key, "vintage": VERSION,
            **describe_file(root, recipe_path), "companions": recipe["inputs"],
            "metadata": {"report_schema": "upstate.observed-report/v1", "project_id": ws.project["id"],
                "terrain_conditioning_report_source_id": key,
                "terrain_conditioning_response_id": original["id"], "terrain_conditioning_case_id": case["id"],
                "classification": "retained completed native terrain-input sensitivity",
                "original_source_classification": binding["source_classification"], "native_calculation": False}}
        atomic_json(root / "sources.json", {"schema": "upstate.sources/v1", "title": selected["title"],
                                          "entries": [entry]}, immutable=True)
        _verify_binding(ws, binding)
        collection = ws.import_sources(root / "sources.json")
        members = [describe_file(ws.root, root / x["path"]) for x in recipe["inputs"]]
        members += [describe_file(ws.root, root / n) for n in ("report-source.json", "sources.json")]
        result = {"schema": SCHEMA, "id": key, "state": "complete", "selection": record, "binding": binding,
                  "directory": root.relative_to(ws.root).as_posix(),
                  "source": {"source_collection_id": collection["id"], "source_id": source_id},
                  "summary": {"native_alternatives": len(binding["alternatives"]),
                              "quantities": list(binding["quantity_support"]),
                              "source_classification": binding["source_classification"]},
                  "files": members}
        atomic_json(root / "result.json", result, immutable=True)
        emit("complete")
        return inspect(ws, key)

def files(ws, key):
    return inspect(ws, key)["files"]

"""Scientific terrain sensitivity reports from original retained native rows."""
from __future__ import annotations
from copy import deepcopy
from pathlib import Path
import json
import math
from model.common import atomic_bytes, atomic_json, describe_file
from model import scientific_report, scientific_figures, native_versions

def show(value):
    if value is None:
        return "Unavailable"
    if isinstance(value, (float, int)):
        if not math.isfinite(value):
            raise ValueError("Retain finite original terrain report quantities")
        return format(value, ".9g")
    return str(value)

def table(columns, rows, caption):
    return {"kind": "table", "columns": columns, "rows": rows, "caption": caption}

def _figure(root, name, figure):
    from reportlab.graphics import renderSVG
    scientific_figures._validate_figure(figure)
    drawings = scientific_figures.panel_drawings(figure, 560)
    if len(drawings) != 1:
        raise ValueError("Retain one terrain quantity per native response figure")
    payload = renderSVG.drawToString(drawings[0])
    if isinstance(payload, str):
        payload = payload.encode("utf-8")
    atomic_bytes(root / name, payload, immutable=True)
    return {"kind": "figure", **describe_file(root, root / name),
            "title": figure["title"], "alt": figure["title"] + ". " + figure["caption"],
            "caption": figure["caption"], "spec": figure}

def _source_sections(root, sections):
    copied, figures, choices = [], [], []
    for heading, blocks in sections:
        source_blocks = []
        for block in blocks:
            if isinstance(block, dict) and block.get("kind") == "figure":
                figure = deepcopy(block["spec"])
                figure["id"] = Path(block["path"]).stem
                figures.append(figure)
                choices.append({"id": figure["id"], "path": block["path"]})
                source_blocks.extend([block["caption"], {"kind": "links", "items": [
                    {"title": block["title"], "path": block["path"]}]}])
            else:
                source_blocks.append(deepcopy(block))
        copied.append([heading, source_blocks])
    if not figures:
        return copied, {}
    name = "scientific-figures.json"
    atomic_json(root / name, {"schema": "upstate.scientific-figure-spec/v1", "figures": figures}, immutable=True)
    return copied, {"figure_spec": name, "figures": choices}

def _guides(binding):
    result, seen = [], set()
    for models in binding["native_versions"].get("runs", {}).values():
        for model, version in models.items():
            uri = native_versions.guide_url(model, version)
            if uri and uri not in seen:
                seen.add(uri)
                result.append([model.upper() + " " + native_versions.version_label(version),
                               scientific_report.link("Original producing-version model guide", uri)])
    method = binding["case"].get("method")
    if method:
        result.append(["Retained terrain conditioning method", scientific_report.link("Original method reference", method)])
    return result

def write(directory, record, original, case, copied):
    root = Path(directory)
    binding = record["binding"]
    source_case = case["case"]
    source_records = [{"id": s["collection_id"] + "/" + s["entry"]["id"],
                       "source_id": s["entry"]["id"], "title": s["entry"].get("title", s["entry"]["id"]),
                       "uri": s["entry"].get("uri", ""), "vintage": s["entry"].get("vintage", "")}
                      for s in binding["original_source_records"]]
    classification = binding.get("source_classification")
    classification_text = show(classification) if classification is not None else "Read the retained original input source record"
    sections = [["Scientific purpose and original source scope", [
        record["reason"], "Original input classification: " + classification_text + ".",
        "This report preserves completed native terrain-input sensitivity on the original fixed lattice. "
        "Land cover, original scenario, parameter profile, non-DEM inputs and native model identity remain those of the retained comparison. "
        "Interpret each changed elevation edition as a conditional model response. A favorable modeled change alone does not establish improved empirical accuracy.",
        table(["Original identity", "Retained value"], [
            ["Project", binding["project_id"]], ["Terrain case", binding["case_id"]],
            ["Native response", binding["response_id"]], ["Original baseline run", binding["baseline_run_id"]],
            ["DEM source", source_case["dem"].get("source_title") or source_case["dem"]["source_id"]],
            ["Original DEM units", "metres"], ["Original lattice columns", source_case["grid"]["width"]],
            ["Original lattice rows", source_case["grid"]["height"]],
            ["Outlet policy", source_case["nodata_boundary"]],
            ["Stream corridor half-width, metres", show(source_case["corridor_half_width_m"])]],
            "Original source classification and complete native provenance accompany every figure")]]]
    sources = []
    for item in binding["original_source_records"]:
        entry = item["entry"]
        sources.append([entry.get("title", entry["id"]), entry.get("role", entry.get("kind", "")),
                        entry.get("classification") or entry.get("data_classification") or entry.get("notes") or "See complete source metadata",
                        entry.get("uri", ""), entry.get("vintage", "")])
    sections.append(["Elevation and hydrography provenance", [
        table(["Original source", "Role", "Classification / notes", "Original URI", "Edition"], sources,
              "Inputs retain their original source labels, including model-derived or simulated provenance"),
        "The selected line source and its original feature filter determine stream-burning support. "
        "The original implementation rasterizes selected linework with all_touched. A source line or stream-cell count "
        "therefore need not equal the count of changed DEM cells.",
        "Entered burn depth is a conditioning choice in metres. Spill-level filling follows that change, so final local "
        "elevation differences need not equal the requested depth. Geometric fill volume describes elevation adjustment; "
        "it does not measure water storage. Local lower/equal-neighbour diagnostics describe cell adjacency, not routed connectivity.",
        {"kind": "links", "items": [{"title": "Complete original DEM, line source and native source metadata", "path": "input-binding.json"},
                                   {"title": "Complete original terrain case and edition statistics", "path": "original-terrain-case.json"}]}]])
    variants = case.get("variants", [])
    variant_rows = []
    for i, variant in enumerate(variants, 1):
        stats = variant["statistics"]
        variant_rows.append([i, variant["name"], show(variant["burn_depth_m"]), show(stats["changed_cells"]),
                             show(stats["changed_area_ha"]), show(stats["maximum_raise_m"]),
                             show(stats["maximum_lower_m"]), show(stats["fill_volume_m3"])])
    for offset in range(0, len(variant_rows), 14):
        sections.append(["Retained terrain editions", [
            table(["Index", "Terrain edition", "Entered depth m", "Changed cells", "Changed ha",
                   "Maximum raise m", "Maximum lower m", "Geometric fill m³"],
                  variant_rows[offset:offset+14], "Area and final elevation diagnostics are copied from the original case")]])
    quantities = list(binding["quantity_support"])
    for metric in quantities:
        rows = [r for r in original["rows"] if r["metric"] == metric]
        units = binding["quantity_support"][metric]["units"]
        for offset in range(0, len(rows), 12):
            chosen = rows[offset:offset+12]
            sections.append([metric.replace("_", " ").capitalize() + " — identical native support", [
                "Every alternative below uses the intersection of valid output cells across the original baseline and ALL "
                "changed alternatives in this saved response, separately for this quantity. Positive change increases modeled "
                "annual export; negative change decreases it. These totals use the original normalized pixel-mass outputs once.",
                table(["Index", "Terrain edition", "Baseline", "Alternative", "Alternative − baseline",
                       "Change %", "Annual mass units", "Common ha"],
                      [[offset+i+1, r["variant"], show(r["baseline_joint_total"]), show(r["alternative_joint_total"]),
                        show(r["change_joint_total"]), show(r["change_percent"]), r["units"],
                        show(r["joint_area_ha"])] for i, r in enumerate(chosen)],
                      "Signed changes retain the original direction and common mask; different pollutants retain distinct annual units")]])
            values = [r["change_joint_total"] for r in chosen]
            lo, hi = min([0.0, *values]), max([0.0, *values])
            margin = (hi-lo)*.12 if hi>lo else 1.0
            title = metric.replace("_", " ").capitalize() + ": retained terrain sensitivity"
            caption = ("Original completed native alternatives in display order, all on identical valid cells for this quantity. "
                       "The points are deterministic model cases. Positive values mean increased stream-delivery export. "
                       "No interpolated response or uncertainty interval is supplied.")
            figure = {"id": "terrain-response-" + metric + "-" + str(offset//12+1),
                "title": title, "caption": caption, "panels": [{
                    "title": "Alternative minus original baseline",
                    "x": {"domain": [offset+.4, offset+len(chosen)+.6], "label": "Terrain edition index",
                          "ticks": [{"value": offset+i+1, "label": str(offset+i+1)} for i in range(len(chosen))]},
                    "y": {"domain": [lo-margin, hi+margin], "label": "Change in annual modeled export", "unit": units,
                          "ticks": [{"value": v, "label": show(v)} for v in sorted(set([lo, 0.0, hi]))]},
                    "series": [{"geometry": "scatter", "label": "Retained native change",
                                "points": [{"x": offset+i+1, "y": r["change_joint_total"]} for i, r in enumerate(chosen)]}],
                    "reference_lines": [{"axis": "y", "value": 0.0, "label": "No modeled export change"}]}]}
            sections.append(["Native terrain response figure", [_figure(root, figure["id"]+".svg", figure)]])
        support_rows = [[r["variant"], show(r["joint_valid_cells"]), show(r["joint_area_ha"]),
                         show(r["baseline_valid_cells"]), show(r["alternative_valid_cells"]),
                         show(r["lost_valid_cells"]), show(r["gained_valid_cells"])] for r in rows]
        raw_rows = [[r["variant"], show(r["baseline_native_total"]), show(r["alternative_native_total"]), r["units"]] for r in rows]
        for offset in range(0, len(rows), 14):
            sections.append([metric.replace("_", " ").capitalize() + " — original output coverage", [
                table(["Terrain edition", "All-alternative common cells", "Common ha", "Valid baseline",
                       "Valid alternative", "Lost versus baseline", "Gained versus baseline"],
                      support_rows[offset:offset+14], "Lost and gained counts compare each alternative with baseline; they are distinct from the all-alternative intersection"),
                table(["Terrain edition", "Original full-support baseline", "Original full-support alternative", "Annual mass units"],
                      raw_rows[offset:offset+14], "These retained original totals can have different valid support. Their subtraction is not the reported common-support effect.")]])
    copied_paths = {m["path"] for m in copied}
    map_links = []
    for row in original["rows"]:
        path = "response/" + row["difference"]
        if path not in copied_paths:
            raise ValueError("The report lost an original native difference map")
        folder = str(Path(path).parent)
        items = [{"title": row["variant"]+" / "+row["metric"]+" — full native difference GeoTIFF", "path": path}]
        for filename, label in (("change.png", "Original grayscale display"), ("preview.json", "Original legend and display sampling")):
            member = folder + "/" + filename
            if member in copied_paths:
                items.append({"title": row["variant"]+" / "+row["metric"]+" — "+label, "path": member})
        map_links.extend(items)
    for offset in range(0, len(map_links), 15):
        sections.append(["Original native difference maps", [
            "Map values retain the original per-pixel annual mass unit. Their common mask matches the corresponding "
            "table quantity. PNGs retain the original display stride and legend; exact analytical values remain in the GeoTIFF.",
            {"kind": "links", "items": map_links[offset:offset+15]}]])
    mask_links = [{"title": Path(p).name, "path": p} for p in sorted(copied_paths) if p.endswith("-joint-support.tif")]
    sections.append(["Scientific interpretation and complete native record", [
        original["interpretation"],
        "Read nutrient and sediment responses together. A decrease in one quantity can accompany an increase in another. "
        "No composite ranking or optimal terrain setting is inferred from these outputs.",
        "An unchanged terrain edition reuses its exact original baseline where the original case records that equivalence. "
        "Retained baseline-reuse editions: " + ", ".join(original.get("baseline_reuse", [])) + ".",
        {"kind": "links", "items": [
            {"title": "Exact native response table", "path": "response/native-response.csv"},

import json

from pathlib import Path

    if args.operation in ("preview", "prepare"):

    elif args.operation != "catalog":

TokenJunkieLabs · Original Upper Savannah application · 13 October 2026

## Complete analyst workflow

Open the original **Terrain editions** desk. A saved terrain case retains the original DEM, any original hydrography, explicit conditioning choices, derived terrain editions and original native run bindings. Open its **saved native response** after the native runs complete.

The source-promotion form gives that completed response a report title and scientific purpose. **Preview scientific source** binds the exact original case, response, source classifications, native output coverage, producing versions and retained native files. **Prepare scientific source** submits the immutable original queue request. This keeps terrain interpretation beside the other original native model studies. The request body is durably retained before dispatch; interrupted submissions recover the same original operation identity.

## Scientific meanings

The response direction is **alternative minus baseline**. Positive change increases modeled annual export; negative change decreases it. For each pollutant, every changed terrain alternative is compared on the same finite-cell intersection of the baseline and all those alternatives. Original full-support native totals remain separately labeled. Pairwise lost/gained counts versus baseline are separate from that all-alternative intersection.

Inputs retain their actual classification and original source metadata. A simulated or model-derived hydrography case stays labeled accordingly. Input burn depth is an explicit metre-valued conditioning choice followed by spill-level filling, and therefore differs conceptually from the final local elevation change. Original all_touched line rasterization can produce a different number of changed DEM cells from an input line/stream-cell count. Geometric fill volume is elevation adjustment. Local adjacency diagnostics are separate from routed connectivity.

Tables use the original annual mass units. Original map pixels retain annual mass per pixel. The adapter uses the existing normalized native quantities and does not multiply by hectares again. Nutrient and sediment changes can have different signs. Original source/model assumptions and analyst interpretation stay alongside the results.

The immutable record kind is `terrain-conditioning-report-sources`. """Original editable terrain cases, native responses and report-source lineage.

TokenJunkieLabs. This resolver reads retained records/CAS only. It never imports
old source-view manifests, conditions DEMs, prepares grids or executes models.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

from copy import deepcopy
from pathlib import Path

from .common import digest, identifier, read_json

CASES = "terrain-conditioning-cases"
BINDINGS = "terrain-conditioning-bindings"
RESPONSES = "terrain-conditioning-responses"
REPORTS = "terrain-conditioning-report-sources"
ROOT_KINDS = (CASES, BINDINGS, RESPONSES, REPORTS)
IMMUTABLE_KINDS = ROOT_KINDS
LABELS = {CASES: "Terrain conditioning cases", BINDINGS: "Terrain native bindings",
          RESPONSES: "Terrain native responses", REPORTS: "Terrain scientific report sources"}
FOLDERS = {CASES: "terrain-conditioning-output",
           RESPONSES: "terrain-conditioning-response-output",
           REPORTS: "terrain-conditioning-report-source-output"}
URI = "urn:upstate:terrain-conditioning-report-source:"


def _immutable(kind, key, value):
    if value.get("schema") != "upstate." + kind + "/v1" or digest(value) != identifier(key):
        raise ValueError("The original terrain record changed: " + kind + "/" + key)
    return value


def _record(closure, kind, key):
    key = identifier(key)
    return _immutable(kind, key, closure.read(kind + "/" + key + ".json"))


def _optional(closure, path):
    target = closure.root / path
    return closure.read(path) if target.exists() or target.is_symlink() else None


def _tree(closure, kind, key):
    prefix = FOLDERS[kind] + "/" + key
    if (closure.root / prefix).exists() or (closure.root / prefix).is_symlink():
        closure.tree(prefix)
    return prefix


def _files(closure, files, prefix=None):
    if not isinstance(files, list):
        raise ValueError("Terrain outputs need their complete original file descriptors")
    seen = set()
    for row in files:
        if not isinstance(row, dict) or not {"path", "bytes", "sha256"}.issubset(row):
            raise ValueError("A terrain output lost its original byte descriptor")
        path = row["path"]
        if path in seen or (prefix is not None and not path.startswith(prefix + "/")):
            raise ValueError("Terrain output paths repeat or leave their original directory")
        seen.add(path)
        closure.add_file(path, row)


def _source(closure, collection_id, source_id, sha=None):
    collection_id = identifier(collection_id)
    collection = _record(closure, "sources", collection_id)
    entries = [row for row in collection["entries"] if row["id"] == source_id]
    if len(entries) != 1:
        raise ValueError("Terrain source choice is absent from its original collection")
    entry = entries[0]
    if sha is not None and entry["body"]["sha256"] != identifier(sha):
        raise ValueError("Terrain source body differs from the retained case")
    closure.need("sources", collection_id, "Complete original terrain source collection")
    closure.add_file(entry["body"]["object"], entry["body"])
    for row in entry.get("companions", []):
        closure.add_file(row["object"], row)
    return entry


def _saved_for_case(closure, kind, case_id, predicate=None):
    # Filter before capture: unrelated records are not silently added to a Study.
    for path in sorted((closure.root / kind).glob("*.json")):
        value = read_json(path)
        if value.get("case_id") != case_id or (predicate is not None and not predicate(value)):
            continue
        key = identifier(path.stem)
        yield key, _record(closure, kind, key)


def _case(closure, key, value):
    closure.need("sources", value["context_collection_id"], "Original terrain context")
    dem = value["dem"]
    _source(closure, dem["collection_id"], dem["source_id"], dem["sha256"])
    if value.get("hydrography"):
        hydro = value["hydrography"]
        _source(closure, hydro["collection_id"], hydro["source_id"], hydro["sha256"])
    prefix = _tree(closure, CASES, key)
    expected = [("raw", None), ("filled", 0.0)] + [
        ("burn-" + str(i + 1) + "-filled", depth)
        for i, depth in enumerate(value["burn_depths_m"])]
    variants = []
    for name, burn in expected:
        row = _optional(closure, prefix + "/" + name + "/variant.json")
        if row is None:
            continue
        if (row.get("case_id") != key or row.get("version") != value["version"]
                or row.get("name") != name or row.get("burn_depth_m") != burn):
            raise ValueError("A retained terrain variant differs from its original case")
        _files(closure, row["files"], prefix + "/" + name)
        source = row["source_entry"]
        if (source.get("conditioning_case_id") != key
                or source.get("conditioning_variant") != name
                or source.get("original_dem") != value["dem"]
                or source.get("original_hydrography") != value.get("hydrography")
                or source.get("grid") != value["grid"]):
            raise ValueError("Terrain variant source binding changed")
        closure.add_file(source["path"], source)
        variants.append(row)
    progress = _optional(closure, prefix + "/progress.json")
    if progress is not None and (progress.get("case_id") != key
                                 or progress.get("version") != value["version"]):
        raise ValueError("Terrain progress belongs to another case")
    result = _optional(closure, prefix + "/result.json")
    if result is not None:
        if (result.get("case_id") != key or result.get("version") != value["version"]
                or result.get("state") != "complete"
                or result.get("case") != {**value, "id": key}
                or result.get("variants") != variants or len(variants) != len(expected)):
            raise ValueError("The completed terrain case lost its exact variant roster")
        # This inventory intentionally excludes the old source-view paths carried
        # in the import manifest; those original bytes live in source CAS.
        _files(closure, result["files"])
        collection = _record(closure, "sources", result["source_collection_id"])
        closure.need("sources", result["source_collection_id"], "Conditioned DEMs and complete source companions")
        for row in variants:
            selected = _source(closure, result["source_collection_id"], row["source_entry"]["id"],
                               row["source_entry"]["sha256"])
            if selected.get("conditioning_case_id") != key or selected.get("conditioning_variant") != row["name"]:
                raise ValueError("The imported terrain variant lost its original case identity")
        if result.get("source_ids") != [row["source_entry"]["id"] for row in variants]:
            raise ValueError("The complete terrain source roster changed")
        original_ids = {row["id"] for row in collection["entries"]}
        if not set(result.get("context_source_ids", [])).issubset(original_ids):
            raise ValueError("Terrain context sources are absent from their retained collection")
    node = closure.nodes[(CASES, key)]
    node.update(title=value["title"], state="complete" if result else (progress or {}).get("state", "prepared"),
                case_id=key)
    if closure.selection["include_related_results"]:
        for kind in (BINDINGS, RESPONSES, REPORTS):
            for related_id, _ in _saved_for_case(closure, kind, key):
                closure.need(kind, related_id, "Saved continuation of the selected terrain case")
    return result


def _grid_binding(closure, key, value, case, result):
    variant = next((row for row in result["variants"] if row["name"] == value["variant"]), None)
    if variant is None or value["source_collection_id"] != result["source_collection_id"]:
        raise ValueError("Terrain binding lost its exact conditioned source")
    grid_id = identifier(value["grid_id"])
    current = closure.read("grids/" + grid_id + "/grid.json")
    if value.get("run_id"):
        run_id = identifier(value["run_id"])
        original_id = identifier(value["original_run_id"])
        run = closure.read("runs/" + run_id + "/run.json")
        original = closure.read("runs/" + original_id + "/run.json")
        if run.get("id") != run_id or original.get("id") != original_id:
            raise ValueError("Terrain native binding run identity changed")
        expected_selection = deepcopy(original["selection"])
        expected_selection["grid_id"] = grid_id
        if run["selection"] != expected_selection:
            raise ValueError("A terrain binding changed inputs beyond its original DEM grid")
        original_grid_id = original["selection"]["grid_id"]
        closure.need("runs", original_id, "Original terrain baseline run")
        closure.need("runs", run_id, "Original prepared or completed terrain native run")
    else:
        original_grid_id = identifier(value["original_grid_id"])
    original = closure.read("grids/" + original_grid_id + "/grid.json")
    if original["spec"]["source_collection_id"] != case["context_collection_id"]:
        raise ValueError("Terrain binding original grid belongs to another context")
    expected_spec = deepcopy(original["spec"])
    expected_spec["source_collection_id"] = result["source_collection_id"]
    expected_spec["input_sources"]["DEM"] = variant["source_entry"]["id"]
    expected_spec["title"] = result["title"] + " / " + value["variant"]
    if current.get("id") != grid_id or current["spec"] != expected_spec:
        raise ValueError("Terrain conditioned grid differs from the original native binding")
    closure.need("grids", original_grid_id, "Original terrain model grid")
    closure.need("grids", grid_id, "Conditioned terrain model grid")
    closure.need("sources", result["source_collection_id"], "Complete conditioned source edition")


def _binding(closure, key, value):
    case_id = identifier(value["case_id"])
    case = _record(closure, CASES, case_id)
    result = closure.read(FOLDERS[CASES] + "/" + case_id + "/result.json")
    if result.get("case_id") != case_id or result.get("state") != "complete":
        raise ValueError("A native terrain binding requires its original completed terrain case")
    closure.need(CASES, case_id, "Original editable terrain case")
    _grid_binding(closure, key, value, case, result)
    closure.nodes[(BINDINGS, key)].update(
        title=case["title"] + " / " + value["variant"], state="prepared",
        case_id=case_id, run_id=value.get("run_id"), grid_id=value["grid_id"])


def _response(closure, key, value):
    case_id = identifier(value["case_id"])
    closure.need(CASES, case_id, "Original terrain case behind native response")
    baseline = identifier(value["baseline_run_id"])
    closure.need("runs", baseline, "Original terrain response baseline")
    case_result = closure.read(FOLDERS[CASES] + "/" + case_id + "/result.json")
    expected_variants = [{"variant": row["name"], "burn_depth_m": row["burn_depth_m"]}
                         for row in case_result["variants"] if row["statistics"]["changed_cells"] != 0]
    actual_variants = [{name: row[name] for name in ("variant", "burn_depth_m")}
                       for row in value["alternatives"]]
    if not expected_variants or actual_variants != expected_variants:
        raise ValueError("Terrain response changed its complete ordered changed-variant roster")
    names = set()
    for row in value["alternatives"]:
        if row["variant"] in names:
            raise ValueError("Terrain response repeats a native variant")
        names.add(row["variant"])
        run_id = identifier(row["run_id"])
        closure.need("runs", run_id, "Original terrain response alternative")
        matching = list(_saved_for_case(closure, BINDINGS, case_id,
            lambda binding: binding.get("original_run_id") == baseline
            and binding.get("run_id") == run_id and binding.get("variant") == row["variant"]))
        if not matching:
            raise ValueError("Terrain response lost its original native preparation binding")
        for binding_id, _ in matching:
            closure.need(BINDINGS, binding_id, "Exact terrain response run binding")
    if value.get("direction") != "alternative minus baseline":
        raise ValueError("Terrain response changed its original signed direction")
    prefix = _tree(closure, RESPONSES, key)
    result = _optional(closure, prefix + "/result.json")
    if result is not None:
        if (result.get("id") != key or result.get("state") != "complete"
                or result.get("schema") != "upstate.terrain-native-response/v1"
                or result.get("selection") != {**value, "id": key}):
            raise ValueError("Terrain native response differs from its frozen selection")
        _files(closure, result["files"], prefix)
        native = closure.read(prefix + "/native-response.json")
        if native != {name: row for name, row in result.items() if name != "files"}:
            raise ValueError("Terrain response machine report differs from its complete result")
        # Copied original run files remain historical source evidence. The live
        # retained runs may subsequently acquire additional original stages.
        _files(closure, result["originals"], prefix)
    closure.nodes[(RESPONSES, key)].update(
        title=(result or {}).get("title", "Terrain response " + key[:12]),
        state="complete" if result else "prepared", case_id=case_id, response_id=key,
        baseline_run_id=baseline)
    if closure.selection["include_related_results"]:
        for report_id, _ in _saved_for_case(closure, REPORTS, case_id,
                                           lambda report: report.get("response_id") == key):
            closure.need(REPORTS, report_id, "Saved scientific source for terrain response")


def _report(closure, key, value):
    if value.get("project_id") != closure.workspace.project["id"]:
        raise ValueError("The terrain report source belongs to another workspace")
    response = _record(closure, RESPONSES, value["response_id"])
    if (response["case_id"] != value["case_id"]
            or value["binding"]["case_id"] != value["case_id"]
            or value["binding"]["response_id"] != value["response_id"]
            or value["binding"]["project_id"] != value["project_id"]):
        raise ValueError("Terrain report source crossed its original case or native response")
    closure.need(CASES, value["case_id"], "Original terrain report case")
    closure.need(RESPONSES, value["response_id"], "Original terrain report native response")
    prefix = _tree(closure, REPORTS, key)
    result = _optional(closure, prefix + "/result.json")
    if result is not None:
        from . import terrain_conditioning_report_source as reports
        checked = reports.inspect(closure.workspace, key)
        if (checked.get("id") != key or checked.get("state") != "complete"
                or checked.get("selection") != {**value, "id": key}):
            raise ValueError("Terrain scientific report source changed its immutable selection")
        _files(closure, checked["files"], prefix)
        closure.need("sources", checked["source"]["source_collection_id"],
                     "Complete terrain scientific report and companions")
    closure.nodes[(REPORTS, key)].update(
        title=value["title"], state="complete" if result else "prepared",
        case_id=value["case_id"], response_id=value["response_id"])


def visit(closure, kind, key, value):
    if kind not in ROOT_KINDS:
        return False
    _immutable(kind, key, value)
    if kind == CASES:
        _case(closure, key, value)
    elif kind == BINDINGS:
        _binding(closure, key, value)
    elif kind == RESPONSES:
        _response(closure, key, value)
    else:
        _report(closure, key, value)
    return True


def lock_paths(closure):
    for kind, key in sorted(closure.nodes):
        if kind == CASES:
            prefix = FOLDERS[CASES] + "/" + key
            yield prefix + "/.case.lock"
            yield prefix + "/engine/.compile.lock"
        elif kind == RESPONSES:
            yield FOLDERS[RESPONSES] + "/" + key + "/.response.lock"
        elif kind == REPORTS:
            yield FOLDERS[REPORTS] + "/" + key + "/.report.lock"


def catalogue(workspace, kind):
    if kind not in ROOT_KINDS:
        return []
    rows = []
    for path in sorted((Path(workspace.root) / kind).glob("*.json")):
        key = path.stem
        try:
            value = _immutable(kind, key, read_json(path))
            state = "prepared"
            title = value.get("title") or value.get("variant") or key[:12]
            result = None
            if kind in FOLDERS:
                target = Path(workspace.root) / FOLDERS[kind] / key / "result.json"
                if target.exists():
                    result = read_json(target)
                    state = result.get("state", state)
                    title = result.get("title", title)
                elif kind == CASES:
                    progress = target.with_name("progress.json")
                    if progress.exists():
                        state = read_json(progress).get("state", state)
            row = {"kind": kind, "id": key, "title": title, "state": state,
                   "updated_at": (result or {}).get("completed_at", ""),
                   "case_id": key if kind == CASES else value["case_id"]}
            if kind in (RESPONSES, REPORTS):
                row["response_id"] = key if kind == RESPONSES else value["response_id"]
            if value.get("run_id"):
                row["run_id"] = value["run_id"]
            rows.append(row)
        except (OSError, ValueError, KeyError, TypeError) as error:
            rows.append({"kind": kind, "id": key, "title": key[:12],
                         "state": "unreadable", "updated_at": "",
                         "error": {"type": type(error).__name__, "message": str(error)}})
    return rows


def include_source(closure, collection_id, entry):
    uri = entry.get("uri", "")
    if not isinstance(uri, str) or not uri.startswith(URI):
        return False
    key = identifier(uri[len(URI):])
    metadata = entry.get("metadata") or {}
    if (entry.get("kind") != "document" or entry.get("role") != "OBSERVED_CONTEXT"
            or metadata.get("report_schema") != "upstate.observed-report/v1"
            or metadata.get("terrain_conditioning_report_source_id") != key
            or entry.get("id") != "terrain-conditioning-report-source-" + key):
        raise ValueError("Terrain scientific source lost its original typed identity")
    members = {}
    for body in [entry["body"], *entry.get("companions", [])]:
        name = body.get("view_path", body["filename"])
        if name in members:
            raise ValueError("Terrain scientific source repeats an original member")
        members[name] = body
        closure.add_file(body["object"], body)
    recipe = closure.read(entry["body"]["object"])
    expected = {row["path"]: (row["bytes"], row["sha256"]) for row in recipe["inputs"]}
    actual = {name: (body["bytes"], body["sha256"]) for name, body in members.items()
              if body is not entry["body"]}
    if (recipe.get("schema") != "upstate.observed-report/v1"
            or expected != actual or len(expected) != len(recipe["inputs"])):
        raise ValueError("Terrain report source lost its complete original report inventory")
    selection_body = members.get("selection.json")
    if selection_body is None:
        raise ValueError("Terrain scientific source lost its immutable original selection")
    selected = closure.read(selection_body["object"])
    raw = {name: item for name, item in selected.items() if name != "id"}
    _immutable(REPORTS, key, raw)
    if (selected.get("id") != key or selected.get("project_id") != metadata.get("project_id")
            or selected.get("case_id") != metadata.get("terrain_conditioning_case_id")
            or selected.get("response_id") != metadata.get("terrain_conditioning_response_id")
            or recipe.get("project_id") != selected["project_id"]):

def _relative(value):

def include(closure, key, record):
    """Retain one completed original edition and its ordered source dependencies."""
    identity = _record(closure.workspace, key, record)
    prefix = KIND + "/" + key + "/"
    result = closure.read(prefix + "operation.json")
    selection_record = closure.read(prefix + "selection.json")

            or result.get("operation_id") != record["operation_id"]
            or any(result.get(name) != value for name, value in identity.items())
            or any(record.get(name) != result.get(name) for name in

                    "figure_count", "sources", "files"))):
        raise ValueError("The completed scientific report differs from its retained edition.")
    selection = identity.get("selection")
    if not isinstance(selection, dict):
        raise ValueError("The saved scientific report needs its original ordered selection.")
    choices = observed_context.source_choices(selection)
    if not choices or len(choices) != record.get("source_count"):
        raise ValueError("The saved scientific report changed its ordered source count.")
    sources = record.get("sources")
    if (not isinstance(sources, list) or
            [{name: row.get(name) for name in ("source_collection_id", "source_id")}
             for row in sources] != choices):
        raise ValueError("The saved scientific report changed its ordered source roster.")
    bindings = [_source(closure, choice, source) for choice, source in zip(choices, sources)]
    binding = observed_context._binding([{"binding": item} for item in bindings])
    if identity.get("binding") != binding or selection.get("observed_context_binding") != binding:
        raise ValueError("The scientific report source bindings differ from the saved edition.")
    files = record.get("files")

        raise ValueError("The saved scientific report has no retained output files.")
    if any(role in files for role in ("operation", "edition")):
        raise ValueError("A saved scientific report uses a reserved output role.")
    retained = {}

    def member(name, expected=None):
        name = _relative(name)
        relative = prefix + name

        previous = retained.get(relative)

            closure.read(relative)

        if not isinstance(descriptor, dict):

        expected_members = {}

                                      for field in ("bytes", "sha256")}

                or descriptor.get("path") != "report-files.zip"):
            raise ValueError("The saved report ZIP differs from its original report files.")
        member("report-files.json")
        member("report-files.zip", descriptor)
        archive = deepcopy(retained[prefix + "report-files.zip"])
    retained_row = {
        "schema": RECEIPT_SCHEMA, "id": key, "project_id": closure.workspace.project["id"],
        "operation_id": record["operation_id"], "title": record["title"],
        "record_sha256": retained[prefix + "edition.json"]["sha256"],
        "operation_sha256": retained[prefix + "operation.json"]["sha256"],
        "render_identity_sha256": digest(identity),
        "source_choices": deepcopy(choices), "sources": deepcopy(sources),
        "source_binding": deepcopy(binding),
        "source_count": record["source_count"], "section_count": record["section_count"],
        "figure_count": record["figure_count"],
        "members": [retained[name] for name in sorted(retained)],
        "report_archive": archive,
    }
    previous = closure.scientific_report_records.get(key)
    if previous is not None and previous != retained_row:
        raise ValueError("The selected scientific report changed during transfer preparation.")
    closure.scientific_report_records[key] = retained_row
    closure.nodes[(KIND, key)].update(
        title=record["title"], state="complete", source_count=record["source_count"],
        section_count=record["section_count"], figure_count=record["figure_count"],
        ordered_source_choices=deepcopy(choices),
    )


def visit(closure, kind, key, value):

        return False
    include(closure, key, value)

def receipt(closure):

def verify_receipt(closure, captured):

def catalogue(workspace):

    root = Path(workspace.root).resolve()
    rows = []
    for path in sorted((root / KIND).glob("*/edition.json")):
        key = path.parent.name

            if path.is_symlink() or path.parent.is_symlink() or not path.resolve().is_relative_to(root):

                              ("source_count", "section_count", "figure_count")}}
        except (OSError, ValueError, KeyError, TypeError) as error:

                   "updated_at": "", "error": {"type": type(error).__name__, "message": str(error)}}
        rows.append(row)
    return rows
